ns2:section.sectionText: Sophomores, juniors and seniors. Meets with INFO 390CWC (55550). This course explores the ongoing restructuring of Chinese and world communications, and the interlocks between the two. We will analyze three unfolding histories: the development of digital technologies, new network systems and new media; changing institutional policies for communications and information; and evolving relations between China and the global political economy. Power dynamics and social and political conflicts will be assessed. A research paper (topic to be approved by instructor) is required.
